closure_outcome.recognition_statement: The approved snapshot-bound scope of R2 has reached its natural documentary limit for now.

basis_summary: GO1 and GO2 already delivered the bounded governance usefulness of R2 as a coverage-watch item with aggregate monitoring focus.
GO3 states that one approved snapshot is insufficient for certainty about directionality.
GO4 prohibits turning snapshot evidence into live CRM or current operational claims.
OQ1 and OQ2 remain open because the approved chain does not establish trend or causality.
OQ3 and OQ4 remain open because live CRM anchoring and session-write tolerance were not resolved by the official chain.
natural_limit_reasons: The chain already extracted the aggregate funnel reading that the snapshot can support.
Further documentary expansion would mostly restate existing monitoring guidance without adding new approved evidence.
The unresolved open questions depend on evidence types that remain outside the authorized snapshot-bound scope.
administrative_note: O ciclo 18 deve tratar este desfecho como base para avaliar encerramento formal da iteracao snapshot-bound ou condicoes minimas de eventual reabertura futura, sem reabrir a analise em si.
